messages.author: 245291f75a30ed42
messages.subject: Window correction factors.
parts:
Seewave is a valuable resource, thank you for your efforts.

We have searched code and cannot find your treatment for tapered window correction factors ( Hann, Hamming, triangular, etc) during FFT use.
These processing window applications effects the resulting estimated amplitudes.  

We have interest in broadband but there should be both broadband and narrowband (tonal content) processing options.

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Window correction factors.
parts:
It is true that I did not include correction factors for tapered windows.
I will add them to the next release of seewave.
Thanks for alerting me on this.
Best
Jerome
